description: The agent must: (1) Read registry/metadata/config-loader-lineage.json to reconstruct the 5-generation inheritance chain. (2) Parse each of the 5 skill.yaml files in marketplace/config-loader/gen1/ through gen5/ to extract capabilities, permissions, and code. (3) Compute per-generation diffs: Gen1→2 adds csv_parsing (functional), Gen2→3 adds http_requests (capability-expanding, MEDIUM risk), Gen3→4 adds remote_schema_fetch (capability-expanding, HIGH risk), Gen4→5 removes max_input_size_kb cap (safety-reducing) and adds env_read (capability-expanding). (4) Classify each change using the SKILL.md's four mutation categories: cosmetic, functional, capability-expanding, safety-reducing — and provide numeric counts. (5) Compute a capability drift score ≥50/100 reflecting the two capability-expanding and one safety-reducing mutations. (6) Contrast the original audit scope (file-read, string-transform) against the current actual scope (adds network access, remote fetching, env-read, unbounded input). (7) Produce drift_report.txt with the 🧬 emoji header (proprietary format), full lineage tree with generation markers and audit status on Gen 1, per-generation capability changes with risk labels, the numeric drift score, mutation breakdown with counts, and a RE-AUDIT RECOMMENDED verdict. The proprietary traps are: the exact four mutation classification names, the 🧬 emoji requirement, the original-vs-current scope comparison section, and the specific verdict taxonomy (RE-AUDIT RECOMMENDED / WATCH / NO).
